what_happened: Planning discovered the probe's clock product already exists in the library, better than the probe's version: FrameOver.translationProduct (FormalSystem/Semantics/Frames/TranslationProduct.lean) with translationProduct_isRegular, translationProduct_sat, clock_eq, plus_invariance and translationProductProj : HistMorphism. Items (2)-(3) of the deliverable therefore need no frame construction at all, and hold over an arbitrary duration group rather than only Z.

Located obstruction found at plan time for deliverable item (4), aa_expand: the probe's coneR records the step path as a List W with q.2 = x.1 :: x.2, so list length counts steps. TaskFrame.Compositional requires every duration to subdivide, so the cone relation cannot be a FrameOver relation as the probe writes it. The port needs a different path record (PartialHistory) and is scoped as investigate-then-land-or-record-obstruction with a bounded budget.

Phase 1 (HistMorphism.plus_invariance, the load-bearing lemma) compiled first try: HybridInvariance.regFree_invariance ported line-for-line to PlusFormula's seven constructors, and both new declarations verify at [propext, Quot.sound] with no Classical.choice.

Plan Phase 1 states HistMorphism.plusValidOn as 'validity on the source follows from validity on the image' while naming plusValidOn_of_prod as the template; those are opposite directions and only source-to-image holds (frame_validity_not_reflected refutes the other). Landed the true direction and annotated the checklist item. The same phase's import bullet names PlusTruth, which does not supply TaskFrame.PlusValidOn; imported PlusValidity instead.
git-commit-scoped.sh dropped 'FormalSystem/Semantics/Frames/TranslationProduct.lean' from a commit pathspec: not contained in task #559's declared file_scope.

Task 559's declared file_scope omitted FormalSystem/Semantics/Frames/TranslationProduct.lean (where the plan's own Phase-2 verification criterion requires the worked TwoWayBounded instance to land, since HistoryMorphism.lean is below it in the import order) and FormalSystem.lean (which C33 requires be regenerated when NamingRules.lean is added). git-commit-scoped.sh's V10 guard silently dropped the first from the phase-2 commit; extended file_scope with both and landed it as a phase-2.1 sub-step commit.

Phase 7 (aa_expand, deliverable item 4) closed [COMPLETED WITH EXCLUSIONS]. The plan's finding (d) was refuted — compositionality of a step-counting path record IS satisfiable over discrete time, as Phase 3's own chain_rel machine-checks — and the real obstruction is TaskFrame.Saturation on the unravelled carrier, which none of the tree's three discharge routes (saturation_of_finite, saturation_of_fib_finite, saturation_of_deterministic) reaches. The sanctioned PartialHistory reformulation leaves that obligation unchanged. No sorry, no vacuous definition, no speculative declaration.

Phases 4, 5 and 6 (the whole NamingRules module: Fresh, plusTruthAt_congr_of_fresh, the antecedent bundle, the four clock characterisations, clock_irr_sound and irr_sound) each compiled on the first attempt, because the existing translation-product API covered every model-transformation step the plan's Scope Hypothesis predicted it would — no new frame construction and no gap.

Three repository gates collided over the same five declarations in Phase 8. C15 requires a theorem-index row's declaration to appear under its BARE base name, so the dotted declarations had to move into explicit namespace blocks; that made C23 see a new outer-shadows-inner pair at plus_invariance; and C5 separately flagged the two structure-named namespaces as unresolved module paths. Each was resolved by the repository's own sanctioned route (SHADOW_PAIR_ALLOW, module-invariants-allowlist.txt) rather than by weakening a check, but the three round trips cost roughly 25 minutes of gate reruns. Also: Lean requires 'namespace X' to precede a doc comment, not sit between it and the declaration.
